entities.name: Medusa actors
entities.evidence: Medusa developers and affiliates—referred to as “Medusa actors” in this advisory—have impacted over 500 victims

entities.name: Medusa
entities.evidence: Medusa is a ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) variant first identified in June 2021

entities.name: Advanced IP Scanner
entities.evidence: Medusa actors use living off the land (LOTL) techniques and legitimate tools, such as Advanced IP Scanner and SoftPerfect Network Scanner

entities.name: SoftPerfect Network Scanner
entities.evidence: Medusa actors use living off the land (LOTL) techniques and legitimate tools, such as Advanced IP Scanner and SoftPerfect Network Scanner

entities.name: certutil
entities.evidence: Certutil (certutil.exe), an administrator utility used to manage public key infrastructure (PKI) and download files, is used to avoid detection when performing file ingress

entities.name: Minidump
entities.evidence: Medusa actors also use Minidump (comsvcs.dll) to avoid detection when dumping Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS) credentials

entities.name: powerfun.ps1
entities.evidence: The obfuscated base64 PowerShell payload is identical to powerfun.ps1, a publicly available stager script

entities.name: Ligolo-ng
entities.evidence: Ligolo-ng o A reverse tunneling tool often used to create secure connections between a compromised host and threat actor’s machine

entities.name: Cloudflared
entities.evidence: Cloudflared o Formerly known as ArgoTunnel

entities.name: Nezha
entities.evidence: An operations and maintenance server monitoring tool used to allow backdoor visibility to compromised hosts from the threat actor’s machine

entities.name: MeshAgent
entities.evidence: MeshAgent, the MeshCentral endpoint agent, connects remote devices to allow threat actors to remotely manage the machine

entities.name: GSocket
entities.evidence: GSocket o Also known as Global Socket or gs-netcat

entities.name: AnyDesk
entities.evidence: FBI identified Medusa actors using remote access software AnyDesk, Atera, ConnectWise, eHorus, N-able, BeyondTrust, SimpleHelp, and Splashtop

entities.name: PDQ Inventory
entities.evidence: The actors use Sysinternals PsExec, PDQ Inventory/Deploy, or BigFix [T1072] to deploy the encryptor

entities.name: BigFix
